moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 110
Accuracy: 70
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.description:
Ice (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description:
Ice (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 1
No additional effect.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description:
Grass (Special)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description:
Grass (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description:
Grass (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description:
Ground (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description:
Normal (Special)
Base Power: 50
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Power doubles if a weather condition other than Strong Winds is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Heavy Rain or Rain, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Intense Sun or Sun. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Heavy Rain, Rain, Intense Sun, or Sun, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.

moves.name: Frost Breath
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 60
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Occa Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fire-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Light Clay
items.description: Holder's use of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, or Reflect lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Icy Rock
items.description: Holder's use of Snowscape lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Big Root
items.description: Holder gains 1.3x HP from draining/Aqua Ring/Ingrain/Leech Seed/Strength Sap.

items.name: Shell Bell
items.description: After an attack, holder gains 1/8 of the damage in HP dealt to other Pokemon.

abilities.name: Snow Warning
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.

abilities.name: Soundproof
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves, unless it used the move.
